purpose: Assemble the already-landed peer-host observation primitives into one host-neutral adapter read contract: a future DAW adapter starts from an exact current WorkspaceMemory observation, submits one bounded observation session containing explicit capability facts, FocusContext facts and Host Shadow facts, and receives one coherent current workspace/studio observation view without every adapter inventing different binding, staleness or truth semantics.

lineage.outcome: Every supported DAW adapter reports observed workspace truth through one peer-neutral contract, so exact workspace/runtime, capability evidence, focus and Host Shadow cannot drift into host-specific parallel models.
lineage.capability: Universal bound host-observation session over WorkspaceMemory + CapabilityEvidenceMemory + FocusContext + HostShadow

why_now: DAW-00A-F are landed on canonical main. A/B/C establish host/workspace/focus identity; D/E establish Host Shadow/reconciliation; F establishes verified capability x exact-environment evidence. The remaining immediate shared blocker is that no canonical adapter-side observation session binds those primitives together before DAW-01 through DAW-06 can implement peer deep adapters.
instead_of: Workspaces/Health capability UI is not selected because no real adapter observation lifecycle yet populates the truthful F substrate; a UI now would be mostly empty or manual-first.

Song version/asset continuity UI is not selected because write semantics exist but normal consumer ingestion still does not consistently create meaningful version/asset material; the current increment unlocks actual making paths more broadly.
Suggestion/template/randomize is not selected because persisted catalog, distance, lock and suppression state is still absent.
OPS-04 is READY but does not unblock the currently blocked Song production journeys or the six peer DAW adapters.
No host-specific adapter is selected because shared observation semantics must exist before one host can define them by accident.

legacy_rejections: silently accepting a stale observation after workspace/runtime changes

completion_proof: one immutable host-observation binding identifies the canonical workspace ID, exact current workspace-observation ID and exact host-runtime fingerprint before adapter facts are accepted
adapter input uses peer-neutral capability/focus/shadow observation values and never supplies a second Song/workspace identity model

all submitted facts are validated against the same expected observation binding before any observation-layer writes begin; a workspace/runtime change invalidates the session before new capability or shadow evidence is accepted
capability facts are persisted only through CapabilityEvidenceMemory and therefore preserve F availability/evidence/preference-separation rules
focus is produced only through FocusContextService for the exact current workspace observation and remains read-only/stale-safe rather than becoming a second persistent selection model
Host Shadow facts are persisted only through HostShadow and bind the exact same workspace observation/runtime evidence

the resulting observation view exposes WorkspaceState + current CapabilityEnvironment/StudioCapabilityProfile + FocusContext + HostShadowState with one shared binding so downstream Recipes and adapters can reason over one environment

partial/failed observation layers are never reported as one successful coherent session; any independently persisted append-only observation remains truthful and inspectable rather than being silently rewritten
all six core DAWs plus GENERIC_OTHER use the identical observation-session contract; no host-specific field, rank or special-case routing is admitted
no observation session mutates a DAW, Song/version/assets, Session memory, EvidenceMemory doctrine, approval, provider or external service

authored tests cover stale binding, cross-workspace facts, capability/shadow/focus mismatch, same-host and peer-host cases, no-mutation invariants and reopen continuity; executed evidence remains separate and UNOBSERVED unless actually seen
next_selection_rule: After DAW-00G lands or blocks, return to the whole graph. Compare remaining DAW-00 mutation/IR/portability/interchange chassis against consumer Workspaces/Health reachability, remaining SONG-01 outcomes, UX and OPS-04. Do not automatically select DAW-00H or any named host adapter.
